context: Ongoing: Building the first three hip and knee actuators. This week: Two hips and two knees built; third hip waits on the stator mount.

Ongoing: Whether the hip keeps the in-house cycloidal reducer or buys a harmonic drive for DVT. This week: Ingrid asks for a decision memo; Tomas concedes backdrivability favors cyclo for the hip at 50:1.
Ongoing: Absolute encoder on the knee output glitches when the motor runs above 8 A. This week: Jonas sees 2-3 count jumps on the knee abs encoder above 8 A phase current.
